description:
Outcome: Club members sign in with their own accounts, from owner setup answers.
Scope: Django login/logout, staff-only account provisioning and credential reset workflow, and authenticated page shell. Excludes: public signup and external identity providers.
Acceptance: Members can sign in/out; anonymous access redirects; staff alone manage accounts.
Behaviour: Clear invalid-login errors and recovery, accessible labels and errors, CSRF protection on mutations, no member-directory leakage.
Verification: Django authentication/request tests and browser walkthrough. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: staff-managed accounts and server-rendered Django pages; about 80 members is context, not a performance target.
title: Member accounts and authenticated pages
